title: Noah's Ark
setup: White's bishop on b3 has its own pawns behind it on a2 and c2, and its own rook sitting on d1.
hint: Count that bishop's escape squares: White's own pawns block two of them, and your b-pawn covers a third.
explanation:
## The Idea

{{c4}} closes the last diagonal. a2 and c2 hold White's own pawns, a4 is covered by the b5-pawn, and the pawn now on c4 is guarded by b5, so Bxc4 bxc4 costs a piece. This net is old enough to have a name: the Noah's Ark trap.
